title: Replace the finder explosion with specifications

task.text: `ApplicantFinder` has one method per combination of rules, each with its own copy of the loop.
Make rules values you can combine. The five existing methods keep their signatures and results, and `Applicant` does not change.

items: `interface Spec<T>` with one abstract method `boolean isSatisfiedBy(T)` and default methods `and(Spec<T>)`, `or(Spec<T>)`, `not()`.
`Specs` with static `Spec<Applicant> atLeastAge(int)`, `minIncome(int)` and `defaulted()`. Bounds are inclusive.

checks.title: Adult and income searches are unchanged
Specs combine with and, or and not
find accepts a rule it has never seen
The old methods delegate to find

hints.text: Each method asks the same question with a different rule. Make the rule a value you can pass around and combine, then keep a single loop.
`Spec<T>` has `isSatisfiedBy` plus default `and`, `or`, `not`. `Specs` returns small lambdas. `ApplicantFinder.find(all, spec)` filters once; the five old methods build a spec and call it.
